question: In which year had India's ratio of public debt to GDP gone up to a record 84.2%?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2003.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **In 2003 India's ratio of public debt to GDP gone up to a record 84.2%.**
 
• The N. K Singh committee on fiscal consolidation recommended that the government should target a fiscal deficit of 3 per cent by March 31, 2020, cut it to 2.8 per cent in 2020-21 and to 2.5 per cent by 2023.
 
• The Committee suggested using the public debt to GDP ratio as a medium-term anchor for fiscal policy in India. 
 
• The committee advocated for a combined Debt to GDP ratio of 60% to be targeted by 2023, with a 40% limit for the centre and a 20% limit for the states.
